006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.markup.IMarkupString;
009import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.markup.MarkupDataTypeProvider;
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
014
015/**
016 * An atomic Metapath item representing a Markup data value.
017 */
018public interface IMarkupItem extends IAnyAtomicItem {
019  /**
020   * Get the type information for this item.
021   *
022   * @return the type information
023   */
024  @NonNull
025  static IAtomicOrUnionType<IMarkupItem> type() {
026    return MarkupDataTypeProvider.MARKUP_TYPE;
027  }
028
029  @Override
030  default IAtomicOrUnionType<? extends IMarkupItem> getType() {
031    return type();
032  }
033
034  /**
035   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
036   *
037   * @param item
038   *          the item to cast
039   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
040   *         cast to this type
041   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
042   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
043   */
044  @NonNull
045  static IMarkupItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
046    try {
047      return item instanceof IMarkupItem
048          ? (IMarkupItem) item
049          : IMarkupMultilineItem.valueOf(item.asString());
050    } catch (IllegalStateException | InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
051      // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
052      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
053    }
054  }
055
056  /**
057   * Get the "wrapped" markup value.
058   *
059   * @return the underlying markup value
060   */
061  @NonNull
062  IMarkupString<?> asMarkup();
063
064  @Override
065  default IMarkupItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
066    return cast(item);
067  }
068
069  /**
070   * Compares this value with the argument.
071   *
072   * @param item
073   *          the item to compare with this value
074   * @return a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer if this value is less
075   *         than, equal to, or greater than the {@code item}.
076   */
077  default int compareTo(@NonNull IMarkupItem item) {
078    return asString().compareTo(item.asString());
079  }
080}
